bug.title: The child's import guard extends trusted-library import rights to agent code that runs inside a trusted library's callback
bug.symptoms: _admit(name) admits any import when _trusted_root_in_stack finds a frame from a trusted root (polars, numpy, pyarrow) anywhere up the call stack. The walk follows f_back without stopping.
